blocks.text: The **long** past passive participle is a full adjective: **напи́санный, прочи́танный, постро́енный, закры́тый** — with **нн** in the long form, one **н** in the short.

items: This is a letter written by my brother.
The books (that have been) read are on the table.

blocks.text: A phrase built on a participle — a **participial phrase** — can stand after the noun, set off by commas, and replaces a **который** clause: *письмо, **кото́рое написа́л** мой брат* = *письмо, **напи́санное** мои́м бра́том*. Participles belong mostly to writing; in speech, **который** is more natural.
**Мно́гие** (*many people, many of*) is an adjective form of **мно́го**: **Мно́гие** ду́мают… *Many people think…*; **во мно́гих** города́х.

exercises.q: *Дом, построенный в 1900 году…* — which means the same?
Long or short? *___ окно* (an open window)
